name: Sonnet growth at a reasonable price
strategy: GARP: quality growth companies with durable competitive advantages, trading at reasonable multiples relative to their growth rates (as of Jan 2026 knowledge). Mix of large-cap tech compounders, healthcare/industrial growers, and financials benefiting from secular trends, avoiding the most extreme high-multiple hypergrowth names while still capturing above-market earnings growth.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This basket favors profitable, cash-generative businesses with 10-20%+ earnings growth trading at PEG ratios generally under 2, spanning digital advertising/cloud (GOOGL, META), semiconductor equipment/networking (AVGO, KLAC), managed care and medtech (ELV, SYK), specialty insurance (PGR), off-price retail (TJX), payments (FI), and disciplined energy (EOG). The mix diversifies across sectors while emphasizing reasonable valuations relative to growth, aiming to outpace a cap-weighted S&P 500 that is heavily concentrated in a few mega-cap names.
